_doc: Archetype by rule for the in-between ground of the pilot centre (P2-004, DELHI_WORLD.md 10 AD2: in-between areas of the seamless centre get an archetype profile by rule first, from land use and the footprint grid). Evaluated per 100 m cell in this order, first match wins. A rule holds when every part it names holds: `osm` (the cell centre lies inside a closed OSM way with one of these tag values) and the footprint bounds (cell figures from the merged footprints of graph.json: coverage = footprint area centred in the cell / cell area; median = median footprint area in m2). Ground inside a drawn polygon of areas.geojson never uses these cells. Run `node tools/bake/areas/derive.mjs --write` to rebuild rule_cells.json after a change; no map or profile value lives here, only which archetype a cell gets.
